s07_leo_annoyed_end.fix: Edit reference image 1 (the approved start): keep everything identical, including the face, mane, body, crop and plate. Change only the expression to mildly annoyed but gentle, copying the brows, eyelids and mouth from the annoyed expression reference. Leo has exactly two eyebrows, one above each eye, drawn once; no second or extra brow lines anywhere on the face. Use the V3 images only for staging, camera and the look of the net; Leo's identity comes from the V4 canonical (rust-orange mane, golden-ochre body, brown eyes, canonical face), never the V3 Leo colours. Leo's mane is the canonical burnt-orange rust colour, more orange than red (not red, not crimson), with the canonical large volume: long layered fuzzy wool locks framing the whole face and covering the upper chest, exactly like the V4 canonical image. Rope labels such as R01 or K-left are notes, never visible text.

s08_milo_surprised_start.fix: Same great-tree dusk scene and camera as the s07 reference, but Milo stands farther from the camera on the path, small in the scene and centred near x=0.50. Size rule CR-14: in this wide shot Milo is small. His whole body from ear tips to feet spans only about 0.34 of the frame height (ear tips near y=0.50, feet on the ground at y=0.84). That is the size he has next to Leo in the trap scene: his whole body is about as tall as Leo's mane is wide. Whole body, both feet, whole tail visible; soft contact shadow; lit like the plate. Expression from the expression reference: surprised, brows high, eyes wide, mouth closed. Milo keeps the V4 canonical design: smooth rounded crown with no tuft, brown eyes, slim build, softly rounded cheeks, fine pale whiskers clearly visible on both sides of the muzzle, a subtle low-contrast central face seam. The pale-cream belly ends above the crotch and a clear taupe-grey gap separates his two slim legs down to both feet. Milo's face must match the canonical exactly: warm taupe-brown felt (not cool grey), large round dark-brown irises with cream sclera and small white highlights filling most of each eye, curved brown brows, a visible low-contrast central face seam from brow to nose, wide softly rounded cheeks, short cream muzzle with a tiny brown nose, fine pale whiskers on both sides.
